high_level_description: The image shows a person in a kitchen setting, preparing to cut a lime on a white cutting board with a black handle. The individual is wearing a dark gray t-shirt and appears to be in the process of slicing the lime with a knife. On the countertop, there is a bottle of Corona Non-Alcoholic beer placed to the left of the cutting board. Behind the person, various kitchen items are visible, including a roll of paper towels, a soap dispenser, and some glassware. The kitchen has a modern design with light-colored cabinets and a window with multiple panes in the background.
